name: Ragged Coat
description: It was someone's best coat once.

name: Oilskin Coat
description: Waxed against the mire. Sheds burning oil.

name: Tallow Charm
description: A saint's candle stub on a string. Superstition, mostly.

name: Rimeglass Shard
description: A sliver of the Page of Stillness, frozen solid. Everything you strike remembers cold.

name: Eye of the Drowned Saint
description: Found on an island no one could reach. It looks at the Blank without flinching.

name: Choir-Bone Ring
description: Carved from a singer's finger-bone. It hums when echoes are near.

name: Oil Flask
description: Throw (F) to splash oil. Oil burns. Creatures in it become Oiled — fire flares on them.

name: Water Flask
description: Throw (F) to splash water: puts out fire, soaks creatures (Wet). Wet things freeze.

name: Choir Tincture
description: Warm, violet, faintly humming. Brother Cale wants it poured into the spring.
